# Jory

> Jory is an AI manager for deskless businesses. Owners and managers teach
> Jory how their business should run, and Jory turns that into text-based
> training, cited procedure answers, quick checks, signed proof, and manager
> follow-up for their teams — over iMessage, with no app to install. Jory is
> free to use.

Jory is used by texting it. There is currently no public developer API,
OpenAPI specification, MCP server, or OAuth endpoint; integrations run
through Jory's own audited capability gateway.
